1	# Protocol B — minimal, neutral scoping of candidate norm-provenance channels
2	
3	**Goal (from QUESTIONS.md):** decide, for a *bounded* list of locally checkable, read-only
4	channel types, whether any could be an **independent** record of *which norm was in force at
5	time t*. "Independent" = controlled by someone/something other than (a) the norm-maker,
6	(b) the executor of the work, (c) the ruling asserting its own effect. Existence/scoping only —
7	**no archaeology**, no evidence acquisition, **never a forced negative**.
8	
9	The research programme's own artefacts (`docs/knowledgeos/**`) are **never** candidates
10	(self-contamination) and are excluded by the classifier.
11	
12	## 1. Candidate channels (exact patterns)
13	
14	| Id | What | Path pattern / source (case-insensitive) |
15	|----|------|-------------------------------------------|
16	| `K-CI` | CI definitions | `.github/workflows/**`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`, `.circleci/**`, `azure-pipelines.yml`, `.drone.yml`, `bitbucket-pipelines.yml`, `.woodpecker*` |
17	| `K-HOOK` | repo-shipped git hooks | `.githooks/**`, `.husky/**`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `lefthook.yml`, `.lefthook.yml` |
18	| `K-CODEOWNERS` | ownership / branch-protection hints in repo | path basename `CODEOWNERS` |
19	| `K-STATUS` | status register / rulings register / in-force record (**outside** `docs/knowledgeos/`) | doc-like ext (`md,markdown,txt,rst,json,ya?ml,toml,csv,tsv`) whose path matches a token in {`program_status,status,ruling(s),register,registry,decision(s),adoption,approval(s),signoff(s),progress,inforce,norm`}, e.g. `docs/implementation/PROGRAM_STATUS.md` |
20	| `K-DEPLOY` | deployment / config state | path token in {`deploy,deployment,release,environment,env,infra,terraform`} or ext `tfstate` |
21	| `K-SIG` | signed commits / tags | **presence** of `gpgsig` header / `-----BEGIN (PGP\|SSH) SIGNATURE-----`; keyring **not** consulted, signatures **not** verified |
22	| `K-LOCALHOOK` | local hooks (`LOCAL_ONLY`) | `.git/hooks/<standard-name>` present, or `core.hooksPath` set |
23	
24	**Host-side channels — `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`** (host not authorized): `K-HOST-AUDIT`
25	(server audit logs), `K-HOST-BRANCHPROT` (branch-protection *enforcement*), `K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS`
26	(PR approvals), `K-CI-RUNS` (CI run history), `K-HOST-MEMBERS` (org/team membership).
27	
28	## 2. Deterministic answer rules (every outcome reachable)
29	
30	Scope = the **local ref set only**; completeness vs the host is never shown. `ND` =
31	`NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`, `IND` = `INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE`. If a channel
32	has **0** located paths → every answer is `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)` (`NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` /
33	`NOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY`). Host rows are `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` for all eight.
34	
35	- **Q1 exists** → `YES_IN_CAPTURE` | `YES_LOCAL_ONLY` (`K-LOCALHOOK`) | `NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` | `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.
36	- **Q2 records** → by **type** only (`CONFIG_RULE`, `STATUS/NORM_RECORD`, `IDENTITY_ATTESTATION`); content not read → otherwise `ND`.
37	- **Q3 controls** → `CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=…]` (count only) | for `K-SIG` `ND(keyring not consulted)` | `LOCAL_MACHINE` (`K-LOCALHOOK`).
38	- **Q4 timestamps independent** → `NO_CLIENT_SET` (git recording times are client-generated; a self-attested timestamp is **not** independence). Content timestamps = `ND`.
39	- **Q5 norm-in-force at t** → `NO_BY_TYPE` for config/attestation channels (a rule/attestation is not a norm-state record); else `ND` — existence never decides this.
40	- **Q6 completeness** → `ND[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]` always (local ref set only).
41	- **Q7 independence** → see §3. Reachable: `IND[…]`, `NOT_INDEPENDENT[…]`, `NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT[self…]`, `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`.
42	- **Q8 reproducible** → `YES_LOCAL` (content-addressed, rerunnable on same ref set) | `NO_LOCAL_ONLY` (`K-LOCALHOOK`, unversioned) | `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.
43	
44	## 3. Independence rule (count overlap only)
45	
46	For each channel compute, over the local ref set, by **count only** (identities never leave a
47	private temp dir):
48	
49	- **W** = the channel's own writer set (author+committer emails over its paths);
50	- **E** = *executor* writers = writers over all tracked paths **excluding every candidate
51	  channel path and `docs/knowledgeos/**`** — so **a channel's own writers are not executors by
52	  construction** (corrects the earlier defect);
53	- **N** = *norm-maker* writers = writers over the rulings/register subset of `K-STATUS`;
54	- `overlap_exec = |W ∩ E|`, `overlap_norm = |W ∩ N|`.
55	
56	Mapping:
57	- Control mechanism **unobservable locally** (`K-CI`, `K-HOOK`, `K-CODEOWNERS` — enforcement is
58	  host/client-side; `K-SIG` — signatures unverified) → **`IND`** with the overlap counts attached.
59	- Mechanism observable (writer-set in repo) and `overlap_norm>0` → `NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT`
60	  for `K-STATUS` (self: it *is* the norm source) else `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm]`.
61	- Observable and `overlap_exec>0` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]` (an **observed** overlap, not a construction artefact).
62	- Observable and both overlaps `0` → **`IND`** `[writer_overlap=0; control_mechanism_unobservable]`
63	  (existence + zero overlap cannot *confirm* a positive).
64	
65	A `NOT_INDEPENDENT` verdict therefore arises only from genuinely observed cross-role authorship;
66	where overlap is unknown or the mechanism unobservable the verdict is `IND` — **never a forced negative.**
67	
68	## 4. Completeness rule
69	
70	**Checkable locally:** existence of the paths/hooks above in the local ref set; per-channel
71	commit-count, writer-**count**, and signature **presence**; writer-overlap counts. **Not
72	checkable locally (declared):** branch-protection enforcement, PR approvals, server audit logs,
73	CI run history, org membership, host push times, and whether the local ref set is complete vs
74	the host. All of these are reported as `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` / `COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN`;
75	content of any file (what a rule or record *says*) is `ND` because content is not read.
76	
77	## 5. Output (written by `scope_b.sh` into an empty `$OUT` outside the repo)
78	
79	- `60_channel_metrics.tsv` — per channel: `channel, paths, commits, writers, overlap_exec, overlap_norm` (counts only).
80	- `61_path_ids.tsv` — `16-hex-id → channel` (no path strings leave the repo).
81	- `58_signatures.tsv` — `commits_total, commits_signed, tags_signed`.
82	- `56_local_hooks.tsv` — `standard_hooks_present, core_hooksPath`.
83	- `70_answers.tsv` — candidate × Q1..Q8 (the §2/§3 mapping), incl. `K-SIG`, `K-LOCALHOOK`, host rows.
84	- `71_overall.tsv` — headline `NIF_A_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`,
85	  `complete_vs_host=NOT_SHOWN`, open/excluded counts, host-channel count, `identity_guard`.
86	- `00_script.sha256`, `00_env.tsv`, `00_errors.tsv`, and `SHA256SUMS` over every emitted file.
87	
88	**Guarantees:** read-only; `LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC` + config isolation (deterministic); no `set -e`
89	(explicit exits 0/1/2/3); own absolute path resolved+hashed **before** the one `cd`; refuses any
90	`$OUT` inside the work tree or `.git`; emits **counts only** — no names, emails, ref names, URLs,
91	owners or path strings; a final `identity_guard` greps `$OUT` for `@`/signature markers and fails
92	closed (exit 1). The **only** content read beyond existence/size/counts is commit/tag object
93	headers for **signature presence** (Q1/Q2/Q7 for `K-SIG` strictly require it); no file blob is read.
94

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scope_b.sh -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
3	# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
4	# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
5	# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
6	# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
7	# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
8	set -u -o pipefail
9	export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
10	  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
11	unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE
12	die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
13	
14	# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
15	SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
16	SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
17	SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"
18	
19	git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.showsignature=false -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never "$@"; }
20	
21	# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.

set -u -o pipefail

unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.showsignature=false -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never "$@"; }

for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

awk '$2=="commit"{print $1} $2=="tag" && $3!=""{print $3}' "$TMP/refs" | sort -u > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/paths" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok lstree $? 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- writer sets (identities stay in TMP; only counts/overlaps leave). E excludes every candidate ----
# channel path + docs/knowledgeos, so a channel's own writers are NOT executors by construction.
cut -f2 "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/candpaths"
EXC=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' )
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -n "$p" ] && EXC+=( ":(exclude,literal)$p" ); done < "$TMP/candpaths"
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- . "${EXC[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"

: > "$TMP/N"
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS" && tolower($2) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/ {print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"
if [ -s "$TMP/npaths" ]; then mapfile -t NP < "$TMP/npaths"
  git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- "${NP[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/N"
  ok writers.norm "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
fi

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only) + path-id map (no path strings) ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -F'\t' -v c="$ch" '$1==c{print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    id="$(printf '%s' "$p" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/W" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    k=$(git log --no-merges --format='%H' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk 'END{print NR}'); nc=$((nc+k))
  done < "$TMP/cp"

  else if (ch=="K-STATUS" && on>0) q7="NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT[self;overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"

  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"

if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\tNO_BY_TYPE(attestation, not a norm-state record)\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"

  printf 'K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\n'
fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")

else
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\n'
fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"
done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall (never a forced negative) + fail-closed identity guard ----
{
printf 'headline\tNIF_A_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK\n'
printf 'complete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\n'
printf 'open_local_candidates\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $8 ~ /^INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'not_independent_by_overlap\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $8 ~ /^(NOT_INDEPENDENT|NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT)/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'not_evidenced\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^NOT_EVIDENCED/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'host_channels\t5\n'
} > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
if grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else
  printf 'identity_guard\tPASS\n' >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
fi

22	**B3: The channel's own writers still leak into E through historic paths, which brings back the known defect (l.53–54, 71–74).**
23	The path universe holds tip paths only, so E excludes only the *current* names of candidate files. Any commit that touched a status/register/CI/deploy file under an earlier name (renamed, moved or deleted before the tips) counts as "executor" work. A rename commit `docs/STATUS.md → docs/implementation/PROGRAM_STATUS.md` changes the old path, which is not excluded, and the new path, which is excluded. Its author therefore lands in both E and W from one channel-only commit, giving `overlap_exec ≥ 1` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]` with no executor work involved. 24	
25	**B4: E does not measure "executor of the work", so `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]` is close to forced (l.74, 91).**
26	- E and W both include **committer** e-mails (`%ce`). On a GitHub remote (ENVIRONMENT.md), squash merges, web edits and UI rebases get a shared platform committer identity. Integrators and reviewers who commit or rebase others' work count as executors by construction, even though they are a candidate independent control.

29	
30	**B5: Q5 (and Q2) assert a negative for K-DEPLOY that existence does not decide (l.125–127).**

Without reading content, whether such a record can show what was in force at t is `NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`, not `NO`. This is a forced negative. 33	---
34	
35	## Non-blocking issues / limitations
36	
37	- **N1:** Q5 `NO_BY_TYPE` for K-CI, K-HOOK, K-CODEOWNERS, K-SIG and K-LOCALHOOK is a type argument made without reading content. For example, a CI gate at commit t *is* the enforced rule at t. Prefer `ND`, or state the argument explicitly as a declared assumption.

39	- **N3:** The path universe holds tip paths only, so a channel that was deleted or renamed before the tips is reported as `NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` even though it is in the captured history. The label should say "at tips", or the universe should be built from history (as in the reference).

45	- **N9:** `ls-tree` runs without `-z`. Paths containing `"`, `\`, tab or newline are C-quoted, so the `:(literal)` pathspec misses them and the ID is computed over the quoted string.
46	- **N10:** Path IDs are unsalted SHA-256 prefixes of predictable strings (e.g. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`), so they can be reversed with a dictionary. This is not an identity leak, but the claim "no path strings leave" is weaker than stated.

50	  - Q4 drops the `content timestamps = ND` qualifier given in §2.
51	  - K-SIG gets no overlap counts, although §3 says "with the overlap counts attached".
52	  - K-LOCALHOOK Q4 = `NONE` is not in the §2 vocabulary.
53	  - Q8 `YES_LOCAL` covers reproducibility only; *independent verification* is not shown.
54	  - The `ND` branch for Q2 (l.126) is dead code.
55	  - The N token `authoriz` is reachable only if another K-STATUS token also matches.
56	  - The script is 167 lines (TASK.md: under ~150).
57	- **N14:** Neutrality: the headline token `NIF_A_…` is not defined in any input file and refers to an outside hypothesis label. Rename it to a neutral token, or define it.
58	- **N15:** Self-contamination: the exclusion covers top-level `docs/knowledgeos/` only, which meets the spec. ROOTS.txt also lists `.claude` and `claude`. If those hold research-programme artefacts, they become candidates. Confirm, or declare.
59

63	
64	| # | Criterion | Result |
65	|---|---|---|
66	| 1 | Read-only safety | **OK.** Only read-only git plumbing and porcelain is used: `rev-parse`, `config --get`, `for-each-ref`, `ls-tree`, `log`, `rev-list`, `cat-file commit/tag`, `--version`. 84	  - `ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree <tip>`

86	  - `log --stdin --no-merges --format=%ae%n%ce -- <N paths>` (N)
87	  - `log --no-merges --format=%ae%n%ce -- :(literal)p` and `log --no-merges --format=%H -- :(literal)p` (**HEAD only**, B1)

89	  - `cat-file commit <c>` and `cat-file tag <o>`
90	- **File test:** `-e "$GD/hooks/<name>"`.
91	
92	Nothing writes outside OUT except `$TMP` and possible parents created by `mkdir -p`. Nothing fetches. Nothing changes config.

K-DEPLOY is grouped with the configuration rules (`cfg=…||ch=="K-DEPLOY"`). It therefore gets Q2 = `CONFIG_RULE` and Q5 = `NO_BY_TYPE(configuration rule, not a norm-state record)`. TASK.md defines this channel as deployment or configuration **state** files, and the pattern also matches release notes and `tfstate`. Without reading content, whether such a record can show what was in force at t is `NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`, not `NO`. This is a forced negative. (The same type-argument for K-CI/HOOK/CODEOWNERS/K-SIG is weaker but defensible; see N1.)

---

## Non-blocking issues / limitations

- **N1:** Q5 `NO_BY_TYPE` for K-CI, K-HOOK, K-CODEOWNERS, K-SIG and K-LOCALHOOK is a type argument made without reading content. For example, a CI gate at commit t *is* the enforced rule at t. Prefer `ND`, or state the argument explicitly as a declared assumption.
- **N2:** `INDEPENDENT` (positive) cannot be reached for any channel in Q7. Q6 has one outcome (`ND`). The headline (l.154) is a constant written before any data is seen. Under existence-only scoping this is defensible, since QUESTIONS.md says to use IND when independence cannot be established. The protocol should still say plainly that a positive cannot be reached locally, and that a constant headline is not a finding.
- **N3:** The path universe holds tip paths only, so a channel that was deleted or renamed before the tips is reported as `NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` even though it is in the captured history. The label should say "at tips", or the universe should be built from history (as in the reference).
- **N4:** Config isolation covers only system and global config. Repo-local config is read: `log.follow=true` would change l.91–92, which use a single pathspec. Also, `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS`/`GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` are not unset, and the reference's `core.fsmonitor=false`/`log.decorate`/`diff.renames` overrides were dropped. The commands used do not refresh the index, so fsmonitor is not triggered.
- **N5:** The peeled tag type is not checked (l.50). A tag that points to a tree or blob becomes a "tip", and `git log --stdin` then fails, leaving E and N empty. The failure is logged (exit 1), but every overlap silently becomes 0.
- **N6:** The identity guard fails open: a `grep` error (rc 2) prints `PASS` (l.162–166). The protocol promises fail-closed.
- **N7:** Errors from `cat-file` in the signature loops (l.105, 109) are not checked, and failures count as unsigned. Tags are counted per ref, not per object. Tags carrying x509 `SIGNED MESSAGE` signatures are missed.
- **N8:** In a linked worktree, OUT is checked against the per-worktree gitdir but not against `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`.
- **N9:** `ls-tree` runs without `-z`. Paths containing `"`, `\`, tab or newline are C-quoted, so the `:(literal)` pathspec misses them and the ID is computed over the quoted string.
- **N10:** Path IDs are unsalted SHA-256 prefixes of predictable strings (e.g. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`), so they can be reversed with a dictionary. This is not an identity leak, but the claim "no path strings leave" is weaker than stated.
- **N11:** Writes outside OUT: `mktemp -d` in `$TMPDIR` holds plaintext e-mails. It is removed by the EXIT trap, but not on SIGKILL. `mkdir -p` can create missing parents of OUT. Both are declared and acceptable, but should be documented.
- **N12:** The "local ref set" includes `refs/stash` and `refs/notes/*`, so results depend on the local stash. Notes trees add hex-named paths to the universe.
- **N13:** Protocol and script disagree in places:
  - Q4 drops the `content timestamps = ND` qualifier given in §2.
  - K-SIG gets no overlap counts, although §3 says "with the overlap counts attached".
  - K-LOCALHOOK Q4 = `NONE` is not in the §2 vocabulary.
  - Q8 `YES_LOCAL` covers reproducibility only; *independent verification* is not shown.
  - The `ND` branch for Q2 (l.126) is dead code.
  - The N token `authoriz` is reachable only if another K-STATUS token also matches.
  - The script is 167 lines (TASK.md: under ~150).
- **N14:** Neutrality: the headline token `NIF_A_…` is not defined in any input file and refers to an outside hypothesis label. Rename it to a neutral token, or define it.
- **N15:** Self-contamination: the exclusion covers top-level `docs/knowledgeos/` only, which meets the spec. ROOTS.txt also lists `.claude` and `claude`. If those hold research-programme artefacts, they become candidates. Confirm, or declare.

---

## Audit by criterion

| # | Criterion | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Read-only safety | **OK.** Only read-only git plumbing and porcelain is used: `rev-parse`, `config --get`, `for-each-ref`, `ls-tree`, `log`, `rev-list`, `cat-file commit/tag`, `--version`. There is no fetch (`GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1`, partial clone refused), no config change and no index or ref write. The only writes are OUT, `$TMP` (removed) and possibly parents of OUT created by `mkdir -p`. |
| 2 | Determinism | **FAIL (B1).** `LC_ALL=C`, `TZ=UTC`, C-locale sort, system/global config isolation, self-path resolved before `cd`, and OUT refused inside the work tree and `.git`: all OK. However, the output depends on the checked-out HEAD, and repo-local config is not isolated (N4). |
| 3 | Boundedness | **OK.** Existence, counts and writer sets only. No file blob is read. Commit and tag headers are read for signature presence, which is justified for K-SIG Q1/Q2/Q7. |
| 4 | Reachability | **FAIL (B2, B5).** Q7 is forced to NORM_SOURCE for K-STATUS. Q5 `NO` for K-DEPLOY is asserted without content. Q7 `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]` is close to forced (B3, B4). Q7 `INDEPENDENT` cannot be reached (by design; N2). |
| 5 | Independence rule | **FAIL (B2, B3, B4).** Current channel paths are correctly kept out of E, but writers leak into E through historic paths, committers and the doc trees. N ⊆ W for K-STATUS. A self-attested record is **not** accepted because of a timestamp: Q4 = `NO_CLIENT_SET`, and Q7 never uses timestamps. That part is OK. |
| 6 | Self-contamination | **OK.** `docs/knowledgeos/` is excluded case-insensitively from candidates, from E (over all history) and therefore from N. See N15. |
| 7 | Identities | **OK.** Only counts, IDs, labels, the git version and hashes are written. Identities stay in `$TMP`, and the guard greps for `@` and signature markers (but see N6, N10). |
| 8 | Neutrality | **OK, with caveats.** There is no scoring or conformance judgement. The constant headline uses the undefined token `NIF_A` (N14, N2). |

## Command inventory (scope_b.sh)

- **Shell built-ins:** `set`, `export`, `unset`, `printf`, `read`, `mapfile`, `cd` (once, l.36), `trap`, `[`/test, `case`, `:` (truncating files in OUT and TMP).
- **Coreutils and related:** `realpath` (l.16, 28, 29, 32), `sha256sum` (l.17, 43, 89), `cut`, `ls -A` (l.31), `mktemp -d` (l.32), `rm -rf "$TMP"` (l.33, trap), `mkdir -p "$OUT"` (l.35), `mv` within TMP (l.54), `sort`, `tr`, `comm`, `awk`, `grep` (l.109, 162), and `find | sort | xargs sha256sum` in OUT (l.43).
- **git** (each call wrapped with `-c core.quotepath=off -c log.showsignature=false -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never`):
  - `rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree`, `--is-bare-repository`, `--show-toplevel`, `--absolute-git-dir` and `--is-shallow-repository`
  - `config --get extensions.partialClone` and `config --get core.hooksPath` (read only)
  - `--version`
  - `for-each-ref --format=…`
  - `ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree <tip>`
  - `log --stdin --no-merges --format=%ae%n%ce -- . <excludes>` (E)
  - `log --stdin --no-merges --format=%ae%n%ce -- <N paths>` (N)
  - `log --no-merges --format=%ae%n%ce -- :(literal)p` and `log --no-merges --format=%H -- :(literal)p` (**HEAD only**, B1)
  - `rev-list --stdin`
  - `cat-file commit <c>` and `cat-file tag <o>`
- **File test:** `-e "$GD/hooks/<name>"`.

Nothing writes outside OUT except `$TMP` and possible parents created by `mkdir -p`. Nothing fetches. Nothing changes config.

**Goal:** does an independent record exist that could establish **which norm (ruling / authorization) was in force at a given time**? "Independent" means maintained by someone or something other than (a) the norm-maker, (b) the executor of the work, and (c) the ruling that asserts its own effectiveness.

For each candidate channel, answer only:
1. Does it exist?
2. What does it record?
3. Who or what controls it?
4. Are its timestamps independently generated?
5. Can it establish the norm in force at time t?
6. How complete is it?
7. How independent is it?
8. Can it be reproduced and independently verified?

**Rules:**
- Existence or scoping only; **no broad archaeology**; do not acquire the underlying evidence yet.
- If independence cannot be established: **INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE**. **Never a forced negative.**

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh (r1) -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE \
  GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\nrepo_local_config\tREADABLE(not isolated; declared)\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + THE ONE tip set (B1/N5/N12) -> tracked path universe at tips ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
# tip set = refs/heads/**, refs/remotes/**, refs/tags/** only (never refs/stash, refs/notes/**); tags peeled; commit-type only
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype)' refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
: > "$TMP/t0"
while read -r o ty; do case "$ty" in commit) printf '%s\n' "$o" >> "$TMP/t0" ;;
  tag) git rev-parse --verify -q "$o^{commit}" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/t0" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok peel $? 0 1 ;; esac; done < "$TMP/refs"
sort -u "$TMP/t0" > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"   # N9: read with -z; an embedded newline is carried as \001 and restored before any pathspec/hash use
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r -z --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr '\n\0' '\001\n' >> "$TMP/paths"
  ok lstree "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- B3/B4: executor set E = AUTHOR e-mails (%ae only) of non-merge commits touching the Protocol-A r1 CODE/TEST
# ROOTS over the full history of the tip set; every candidate-channel GLOB pattern and docs/knowledgeos/** excluded.
ROOTS=( app routes database resources config bootstrap lang public tests )
CHG=( '.github/workflows/**' '.gitlab-ci.yml' '**/jenkinsfile' '.circleci/**' 'azure-pipelines.yml' '.drone.yml' 'bitbucket-pipelines.yml'
  '.woodpecker*' '.woodpecker*/**' '.githooks/**' '.husky/**' '.pre-commit-config.yaml' '**/lefthook.yml' '**/.lefthook.yml' '**/codeowners' '**/*.tfstate' )
for t in program_status status ruling rulings register registry decision decisions adoption adoptions approval approvals signoff signoffs progress inforce norm; do
  for x in md markdown txt rst json yaml yml toml csv tsv; do CHG+=( "**/$t.$x" "**/$t[._-]*.$x" "**/$t/**/*.$x" "**/$t[._-]*/**/*.$x" ); done; done
for t in deploy deployment release environment env infra terraform; do CHG+=( "**/$t" "**/$t/**" "**/$t[._-]*" "**/$t[._-]*/**" ); done
PS=( ); for r in "${ROOTS[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(literal)$r" ); done
PS+=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' ); for g in "${CHG[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(exclude,glob,icase)$g" ); done
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${PS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"
ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; nE=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/E")
# B2: norm-register paths (K-STATUS rulings/register subset); N_c = their authors MINUS candidate c's own paths
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS"{p=$0; sub(/^[^\t]*\t/,"",p); if (tolower(p) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/) print p}' \
  "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only; W, commits, N_c all via --stdin over the one tip set) + path-id map ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -v c="$ch" 'index($0, c "\t")==1{print substr($0, length(c)+2)}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do pr="${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}"
    id="$(printf '%s' "$pr" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- ":(literal)$pr" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/w1" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    nc=$((nc + $(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/w1"))); cat "$TMP/w1" >> "$TMP/W"
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  comm -23 "$TMP/npaths" "$TMP/cp" > "$TMP/ncp"; nnp=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/ncp"); : > "$TMP/Nc"
  if [ -s "$TMP/ncp" ]; then NPS=( ); while IFS= read -r p; do NPS+=( ":(literal)${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}" ); done < "$TMP/ncp"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${NPS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Nc"
    ok "writers.norm.$ch" "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
  fi
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu"); nn=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Nc")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/Nc" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" "$nnp" "$nn" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1))
done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0
while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1))
done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
NA8='NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)'
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" -v nE="$nE" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"; na="NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0; nnp=$7+0; nn=$8+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS",na,na,na,na,na,na,na; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":"STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)")
  ov="overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" (nnp>0 ? on : "NA")
  if (ch=="K-STATUS") q7="SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;" ov "]"
  else if (nnp==0) q7=IND "[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate;" ov "]"
  else if (cfg) q7=IND "[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;" ov "]"
  else if (nw==0 || nn==0 || nE==0) q7=IND "[empty_set;W=" nw ";N_c=" nn ";E=" nE "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7="INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",ND,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"

unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE \
  GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\nrepo_local_config\tREADABLE(not isolated; declared)\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + THE ONE tip set (B1/N5/N12) -> tracked path universe at tips ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
# tip set = refs/heads/**, refs/remotes/**, refs/tags/** only (never refs/stash, refs/notes/**); tags peeled; commit-type only
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype)' refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
: > "$TMP/t0"
while read -r o ty; do case "$ty" in commit) printf '%s\n' "$o" >> "$TMP/t0" ;;
  tag) git rev-parse --verify -q "$o^{commit}" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/t0" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok peel $? 0 1 ;; esac; done < "$TMP/refs"
sort -u "$TMP/t0" > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"   # N9: read with -z; an embedded newline is carried as \001 and restored before any pathspec/hash use
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r -z --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr '\n\0' '\001\n' >> "$TMP/paths"
  ok lstree "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- B3/B4: executor set E = AUTHOR e-mails (%ae only) of non-merge commits touching the Protocol-A r1 CODE/TEST
# ROOTS over the full history of the tip set; every candidate-channel GLOB pattern and docs/knowledgeos/** excluded.
ROOTS=( app routes database resources config bootstrap lang public tests )
CHG=( '.github/workflows/**' '.gitlab-ci.yml' '**/jenkinsfile' '.circleci/**' 'azure-pipelines.yml' '.drone.yml' 'bitbucket-pipelines.yml'
  '.woodpecker*' '.woodpecker*/**' '.githooks/**' '.husky/**' '.pre-commit-config.yaml' '**/lefthook.yml' '**/.lefthook.yml' '**/codeowners' '**/*.tfstate' )
for t in program_status status ruling rulings register registry decision decisions adoption adoptions approval approvals signoff signoffs progress inforce norm; do
  for x in md markdown txt rst json yaml yml toml csv tsv; do CHG+=( "**/$t.$x" "**/$t[._-]*.$x" "**/$t/**/*.$x" "**/$t[._-]*/**/*.$x" ); done; done
for t in deploy deployment release environment env infra terraform; do CHG+=( "**/$t" "**/$t/**" "**/$t[._-]*" "**/$t[._-]*/**" ); done
PS=( ); for r in "${ROOTS[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(literal)$r" ); done
PS+=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' ); for g in "${CHG[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(exclude,glob,icase)$g" ); done
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${PS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"
ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; nE=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/E")
# B2: norm-register paths (K-STATUS rulings/register subset); N_c = their authors MINUS candidate c's own paths
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS"{p=$0; sub(/^[^\t]*\t/,"",p); if (tolower(p) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/) print p}' \
  "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only; W, commits, N_c all via --stdin over the one tip set) + path-id map ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -v c="$ch" 'index($0, c "\t")==1{print substr($0, length(c)+2)}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do pr="${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}"
    id="$(printf '%s' "$pr" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- ":(literal)$pr" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/w1" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    nc=$((nc + $(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/w1"))); cat "$TMP/w1" >> "$TMP/W"
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  comm -23 "$TMP/npaths" "$TMP/cp" > "$TMP/ncp"; nnp=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/ncp"); : > "$TMP/Nc"
  if [ -s "$TMP/ncp" ]; then NPS=( ); while IFS= read -r p; do NPS+=( ":(literal)${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}" ); done < "$TMP/ncp"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${NPS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Nc"
    ok "writers.norm.$ch" "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
  fi
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu"); nn=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Nc")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/Nc" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" "$nnp" "$nn" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1))
done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0
while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1))
done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
NA8='NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)'
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" -v nE="$nE" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"; na="NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0; nnp=$7+0; nn=$8+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS",na,na,na,na,na,na,na; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":"STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)")
  ov="overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" (nnp>0 ? on : "NA")
  if (ch=="K-STATUS") q7="SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;" ov "]"
  else if (nnp==0) q7=IND "[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate;" ov "]"
  else if (cfg) q7=IND "[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;" ov "]"
  else if (nw==0 || nn==0 || nE==0) q7=IND "[empty_set;W=" nw ";N_c=" nn ";E=" nE "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7="INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",ND,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
read -r nC nSg nTg < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["commits_total"]+0, v["commits_signed"]+0, v["tags_signed"]+0}' "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv")
if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf "K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS\t$NA8\n"
fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")
if [ "$hn" -gt 0 ] || [ "$hpv" = set ]; then
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tYES_LOCAL_ONLY\tCONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)\tLOCAL_MACHINE\tNONE\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(local, unversioned)\tNO_LOCAL_ONLY(not versioned; not reproducible from the ref set)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf "K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\t$NA8\n"
fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"
done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall: headline COMPUTED from the per-channel Q7 values (N2/N14) + fail-closed identity guard (N6) ----
q7n() { awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" 'NR>1 && $8 ~ r {c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"; }
nI=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL'); nD=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE'); nX=$(q7n '^NOT_INDEPENDENT'); nA=$(q7n '^SELF_ATTESTED')
if [ "$nI" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL; elif [ "$nD" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
elif [ $((nX+nA)) -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED; else HL=LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED; fi
{
printf 'headline\t%s\n' "$HL"
printf 'complete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\n'
printf 'independent_at_identity_count_level\t%s\nopen_local_candidates\t%s\nnot_independent_by_overlap\t%s\nself_attested\t%s\n' "$nI" "$nD" "$nX" "$nA"
printf 'not_evidenced\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^NOT_EVIDENCED/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'executor_writers\t%s\nhost_channels\t5\n' "$nE"
} > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; g=$?
if [ "$g" -eq 1 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tPASS\n' >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
elif [ "$g" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(grep_rc=%s)\n' "$g" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1; fi
finish "$code"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.showsignature=false -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + local ref set -> tracked path universe (existence/scoping only) ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype) %(*objectname)' > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
awk '$2=="commit"{print $1} $2=="tag" && $3!=""{print $3}' "$TMP/refs" | sort -u > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/paths" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok lstree $? 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- writer sets (identities stay in TMP; only counts/overlaps leave). E excludes every candidate ----
# channel path + docs/knowledgeos, so a channel's own writers are NOT executors by construction.
cut -f2 "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/candpaths"
EXC=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' )
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -n "$p" ] && EXC+=( ":(exclude,literal)$p" ); done < "$TMP/candpaths"
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- . "${EXC[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"
ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
: > "$TMP/N"
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS" && tolower($2) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/ {print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"
if [ -s "$TMP/npaths" ]; then mapfile -t NP < "$TMP/npaths"
  git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- "${NP[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/N"
  ok writers.norm "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
fi

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only) + path-id map (no path strings) ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -F'\t' -v c="$ch" '$1==c{print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    id="$(printf '%s' "$p" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/W" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    k=$(git log --no-merges --format='%H' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk 'END{print NR}'); nc=$((nc+k))
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/N" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1))
done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0
while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1))
done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS"||ch=="K-DEPLOY")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":ND)
  q5=cfg?"NO_BY_TYPE(configuration rule, not a norm-state record)":ND
  if (ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS") q7=IND"[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (ch=="K-STATUS" && on>0) q7="NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT[self;overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7=IND"[writer_overlap=0;control_mechanism_unobservable]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",q5,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
read -r nC nSg nTg < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["commits_total"]+0, v["commits_signed"]+0, v["tags_signed"]+0}' "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv")
if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\tNO_BY_TYPE(attestation, not a norm-state record)\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf 'K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\n'
fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")
if [ "$hn" -gt 0 ] || [ "$hpv" = set ]; then
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tYES_LOCAL_ONLY\tCONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)\tLOCAL_MACHINE\tNONE\tNO_BY_TYPE\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(local, unversioned)\tNO_LOCAL_ONLY(not versioned; not reproducible from the ref set)\n' "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\n'
fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"
done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall (never a forced negative) + fail-closed identity guard ----
{

else

fi
finish "$code"

SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

  else if (cfg) q7=IND "[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;" ov "]"
  else if (nw==0 || nn==0 || nE==0) q7=IND "[empty_set;W=" nw ";N_c=" nn ";E=" nE "]"

  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"

  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"

read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")

if [ "$nI" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL; elif [ "$nD" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
elif [ $((nX+nA)) -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED; else HL=LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED; fi

printf 'headline\t%s\ncomplete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\nindependent_at_identity_count_level\t%s\nopen_local_candidates\t%s\nnot_independent_by_overlap\t%s\nself_attested\t%s\nnot_evidenced\t%s\nhost_channels\t5\n' \
  "$HL" "$nI" "$nD" "$nX" "$nA" "$nNE" > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; g=$?

elif [ "$g" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(grep_rc=%s)\n' "$g" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1; fi
finish "$code"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh (r1) -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE \
  GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done

printf 'git_version\t%s\nrepo_local_config\tREADABLE(not isolated; declared)\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"

    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- ":(literal)$pr" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/w1" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    nc=$((nc + $(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/w1"))); cat "$TMP/w1" >> "$TMP/W"
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  comm -23 "$TMP/npaths" "$TMP/cp" > "$TMP/ncp"; nnp=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/ncp"); : > "$TMP/Nc"
  if [ -s "$TMP/ncp" ]; then NPS=( ); while IFS= read -r p; do NPS+=( ":(literal)${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}" ); done < "$TMP/ncp"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${NPS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Nc"
    ok "writers.norm.$ch" "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
  fi
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu"); nn=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Nc")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/Nc" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" "$nnp" "$nn" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1))
done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0
while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1))
done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
NA8='NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)'
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" -v nE="$nE" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"; na="NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0; nnp=$7+0; nn=$8+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS",na,na,na,na,na,na,na; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":"STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)")
  ov="overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" (nnp>0 ? on : "NA")
  if (ch=="K-STATUS") q7="SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;" ov "]"
  else if (nnp==0) q7=IND "[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate;" ov "]"
  else if (cfg) q7=IND "[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;" ov "]"
  else if (nw==0 || nn==0 || nE==0) q7=IND "[empty_set;W=" nw ";N_c=" nn ";E=" nE "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7="INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",ND,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
read -r nC nSg nTg < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["commits_total"]+0, v["commits_signed"]+0, v["tags_signed"]+0}' "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv")
if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf "K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS\t$NA8\n"
fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")
if [ "$hn" -gt 0 ] || [ "$hpv" = set ]; then
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tYES_LOCAL_ONLY\tCONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)\tLOCAL_MACHINE\tNONE\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(local, unversioned)\tNO_LOCAL_ONLY(not versioned; not reproducible from the ref set)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf "K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\t$NA8\n"
fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"
done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall: headline COMPUTED from the per-channel Q7 values (N2/N14) + fail-closed identity guard (N6) ----
q7n() { awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" 'NR>1 && $8 ~ r {c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"; }
nI=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL'); nD=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE'); nX=$(q7n '^NOT_INDEPENDENT'); nA=$(q7n '^SELF_ATTESTED')
if [ "$nI" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL; elif [ "$nD" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
elif [ $((nX+nA)) -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED; else HL=LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED; fi
{
printf 'headline\t%s\n' "$HL"
printf 'complete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\n'
printf 'independent_at_identity_count_level\t%s\nopen_local_candidates\t%s\nnot_independent_by_overlap\t%s\nself_attested\t%s\n' "$nI" "$nD" "$nX" "$nA"
printf 'not_evidenced\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^NOT_EVIDENCED/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'executor_writers\t%s\nhost_channels\t5\n' "$nE"
} > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; g=$?
if [ "$g" -eq 1 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tPASS\n' >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
elif [ "$g" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(grep_rc=%s)\n' "$g" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1; fi
finish "$code"
